body.objective: Decide whether the two strict local Weyl-anomaly classes remain nontrivial after restriction to the programme's selected cylinder/Taub and Berger classical sectors.
body.stop_condition: Import the exact strict local representatives [omega C^2] and [omega E_4] and the frozen classical chain maps rather than reconstructing either side.  For each of the vacuum-cylinder causal complex, the Taub-zero derived fibre with its residual SO(4,2) action, and the declared fixed-coupling Berger sector, construct the induced cochain pullback/descent map and determine separately whether each class is zero, exact with an explicit local counterterm witness, or nontrivial with an explicit cocycle/cokernel witness.  Background pointwise vanishing on a conformally flat metric is not a result: the calculation must cover the allowed fluctuation complex and identify the first nonzero perturbative order.  If an imported chain map is insufficient, emit the exact missing carrier or map as a typed request and return SHORTFALL.  Produce exact certificates, an independent verifier, a sector-by-sector claim table, and dependency tags.
body.current_gate: exact restriction of the two strict anomaly classes to the selected physical-sector complexes
body.forbid: no inference from background conformal flatness; no AFN0 result promoted to full antifield cohomology; no Euclidean/local result promoted to Lorentzian QME or Hadamard; no claim that strict Weyl gravity is anomaly-free unless both classes are trivial on the complete declared restricted complex; no use of the obstructed Candidate A or B actions
activates: a scoped strict-sector quantum preservation theorem if both classes restrict trivially
or an exact sector-specific anomaly obstruction if either class survives
body.resource_hint: QUANTUM PROOF-FIRST.  Prefer exact cochain maps, canonical reductions and witness export; this is independent of selecting a compensator action.
notes: The strict full local theory is anomalous, but the flagship cylinder interpretation uses a much smaller derived zero-charge sector.
The result must distinguish the vacuum cylinder, Taub-zero fibre and Berger fixed-coupling sector rather than silently identifying them.
A surviving class should be connected to the residual D-Cartan question only in the dependent work item.
